newsitem.title: UK: British Energy sales rise in November.
newsitem.headline: British Energy sales rise in November.

text.p: Nuclear electricity producer British Energy Plc said on Wednesday total sales reached 6.26 Terawatt hours (TWh) in November from 5.33 a year ago.
A Terawatt hour is the largest unit of measurement for electricity sales, representing one billion kilowatt hours.
The following table details sales from each power station in TWh. Comparisons are with November 1995:
British Energy said total sales in the year to end-November were 43.52 TWh, up from 38.75 TWh a year ago.
It said its power stations achieved a record week's output of 1.5 TWh in the last week of November, beating a previous landmark set in May 1996.
